facts.did: 从集群（clustering）状态中恢复意识，感到恐惧，体内像积聚了毒素
facts.anchor: Gardenpath came to consciousness with a sense of dread.

facts.did: 反复把一只手臂伸进一本膨胀的书里再抽出（只留一只眼睛耷拉在膜外，懒懒跟着 Gardenpath 的动作）
facts.anchor: inserting an arm into it, then withdrawing it again

facts.did: 说自己必须尽快应考第三次，并替 Plumline 当某人的 examiner 去做当日第二场 seminar 的 guest lecture
facts.anchor: They’re serving as some poor sod’s examiner, so I’m subbing

facts.did: Science Director（科学总监）现身考场后宣布没人坐在自己应在的位置上
facts.anchor: Apparently no one is sitting in their proper places.

facts.did: 说自己正在读 Gardenpath 关于“the Unnamed”这个物种的数据，并指出那是其目录里唯一被真正命名的物种
facts.anchor: the only species you actually do name in your catalog

facts.did: 答称发现了一种新的细胞，能让周围所有细胞聚拢，数万亿细胞因这些 director cells 而聚在一起
facts.anchor: can cluster together because of these director cells

facts.did: 说其中一只 Unnamed 碰过自己（当时穿着可转换化学信号的改性 galaxysuit），几乎让其聚类并开始失去意识
facts.anchor: it almost made me cluster. I started to lose consciousness

facts.did: 给出评价：这很不寻常，且“可能有趣”（possibly interesting）
facts.anchor: It is very unusual. And possibly interesting.

relations.relation: clustermate（同一集群的伙伴）；其随口之言是 Gardenpath 听过的最好的话
relations.anchor: was the nicest thing their clustermate had ever said

relations.relation: Arch 是被 Gardenpath 选定的 examiner，负责问第一题并在整场考试中担任 moderator
relations.anchor: would ask the first question and take on the role

relations.relation: Plumline 对 Wainscot 目前的衰弱状态负有责任
relations.anchor: who was responsible for Wainscot’s current diminished state

relations.relation: 考官 Plumline 直接向 Gardenpath 追问 Unnamed 能否影响人
relations.anchor: They affect people? How do you know that?
